title: Abductees tell Alberino of a forced hybrid breeding program

tellings.quote: being abducted and they're being integrated into this breeding program forcibly.

plain: People who say they were abducted describe being forced into a breeding program that makes hybrids of humans and the beings who take them. Tim Alberino, a guest who has collected such accounts, tells Michels this as what the abductees have told him. If true, the abductions would be part of a deliberate program rather than random encounters.
